opinions.text: C. A. 9th Cir. Motion for leave to proceed in forma pauperis and certiorari granted. Upon representations of the Solicitor General, set forth in his Memorandum for the United States filed June 16, 1972, judgment vacated and case remanded for further consideration in light of position presently asserted by the Government. Application for bail denied without prejudice to renewal of application to the Court of Appeals.
